definitions.explanation: A forceful forward movement against an enemy in a military or competitive context. Implies aggressive, forward momentum.

examples.japanese: {全軍|ぜんぐん}、{進撃|しんげき}⟦せよ→する：00392_suru⟧！
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陣地|じんち}→陣地：30721_jinchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{進撃|しんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}した→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧。
examples.english: They began their advance toward the enemy's position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{進撃|しんげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}めなかった→緩める：15263_yurumeru⟧。
examples.english: Despite fierce resistance, the troops did not let up their advance.

notes:
A military term meaning to advance aggressively against an enemy. Can also be used figuratively for rapid progress or unstoppable momentum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進撃|しんげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to advance, to charge)
- {進撃|しんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}する→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧ (to begin an advance)
- {進撃|しんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue advancing)
- {怒涛|どとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進撃|しんげき} (furious advance)

Widely known from the manga and anime title {進撃|しんげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{巨人|きょじん}→巨人：12432_kyojin⟧ (Attack on Titan).
